# Margot

> Margot is a wardrobe app and an AI-assisted personal stylist for iPhone and Android. It suggests outfits from clothes the user already owns, with the weather in mind, and prepares one outfit each morning before the time the user gets dressed.

Free to download. The free plan allows up to 15 pieces and 5 outfit generations a day. Margot Premium removes the 15-piece limit, raises usage limits and adds outfits for calendar events and chosen occasions. Prices differ by country and store (on 4 October 2026: $14.99 a month, $59.99 a year or $8.99 a week on the US App Store; €14.90, €59.99 or €9.90 in France; £12.90, £59.99 or £8.90 in the UK). There is no free trial. Current prices are shown in the app before purchase.

## Product

Users add clothing photos to a digital wardrobe (the piece is recognised: category, colours, fabric), get outfit ideas, save looks and log what they wear. Other features: avatar try-on, a stylist chat, a buy / consider / skip verdict before a purchase, a Vinted listing written on request for any piece, cost-per-wear stats, trip packing (first trip free) and 12-season colour analysis from a photo. There is no social feed and no data export. The app is available in English, French and Spanish.

Users choose the photos they submit. Data is stored on servers in London (UK); photos are analysed by Google Gemini for the app's features, as the privacy policy explains. Do not infer that every AI operation is performed on-device or in a single region.

## En français

Margot est une application de dressing et une styliste personnelle assistée par l'IA, sur iPhone et Android. Ajoute tes vêtements : chaque matin, une tenue t'attend avant ton heure d'habillage, selon la météo. Gratuite jusqu'à 15 pièces ; Premium à 14,90 € par mois, 59,99 € par an ou 9,90 € par semaine sur l'App Store France (4 octobre 2026).
